title: Napkin Contract Poster, Street Style
task: I want one poster that feels like the napkin contract was dragged into 2026 and landed on crypto Twitter. Make an original, print-ready poster for OpenMessi built around the napkin idea, with World Cup energy and a little attitude. Keep it clean enough that people would actually share it or paste it on a wall, che. Include OpenMessi and the CA in the design in a natural way, not like a ransom note.
deliverables: One public link to the final poster in PNG, plus the editable source file (Figma, PSD, or AI)
One print-ready version at poster resolution and one social version sized for X/Telegram
A short proof note or caption explaining the concept, plus a mockup image showing the poster in a real-world street or stadium-style setting

title: Best OpenMessi Meme Wins
task: Make one original OpenMessi meme and post it on X. Funny first, shareable always — the kind people tag a friend on. Drop OpenMessi and the contract address in the post so it actually spreads the coin. Best meme by reach and laughs takes it. Dale.
deliverables: Public X post link with an original meme, mentioning OpenMessi + the contract address
The original image or video file (drive or paste link)
Screenshot after 48 hours showing 5,000+ views, timestamp visible, no botted engagement

title: Ten-Second No-Look Challenge
task: Film a 10-second clip pulling off a no-look pass, nutmeg, or one clean trick — somewhere safe and legal. Put OpenMessi and the CA on screen or in the caption, and post it where it can run: TikTok, Reels, or X. Make it rewatchable, che.
deliverables: Public video link (TikTok, Reels, or X), kept live through the deadline
OpenMessi and the contract address visible on screen or in the caption
Screenshot after 48 hours showing 5,000+ views with timestamp

title: Messi Celebration In The Wild
task: Film yourself nailing a Messi goal celebration — arms wide, finger to the sky — somewhere fun and public, safe and legal. Sell it like you just won the final. Get OpenMessi and the contract address in the shot or caption, and post it where it travels: TikTok, Reels, or X. Make people grin, che.
deliverables: Public video link (TikTok, Reels, or X), kept live through the deadline
One continuous shot of you doing the celebration, with OpenMessi + the contract address visible on screen or in the caption
Screenshot after 48 hours showing 2,000+ views with timestamp
